def matrix_free_spectral_embedding(
    counts: np.ndarray,
    n_components: int,
    random_state: int = 0,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return leading spectral coordinates for a cell-by-feature count matrix."""
    n_cells, n_features = counts.shape
    if not np.isfinite(counts).all() or (counts < 0).any():
        raise ValueError("counts must be finite and nonnegative")
    if (counts.sum(axis=1) == 0).any():
        raise ValueError("counts must not have all-zero cell rows")
    if not (1 <= n_components < n_cells):
        raise ValueError("n_components must be 1 <= n_components < n_cells")
    
    from scipy.sparse.linalg import LinearOperator, eigsh
    # Ensure float to avoid overflow and support matrix-free multiplication
    counts = counts.astype(np.float64)
    def matvec(v):
        return counts @ (counts.T @ v)
    CCT = LinearOperator((n_cells, n_cells), matvec=matvec, dtype=np.float64)
    
    rng = np.random.RandomState(random_state)
    v0 = rng.rand(n_cells).astype(np.float64)
    eigenvalues, eigenvectors = eigsh(CCT, k=n_components, which='LM', v0=v0)
    # eigsh returns eigenvalues in ascending order, reverse to descending
    eigenvalues = eigenvalues[::-1]
    eigenvectors = eigenvectors[:, ::-1]
    return eigenvalues, eigenvectors
